interpretation: Snapshot of historical training runs; PASS rows are reduced debug models, NOT full K3 passes. Pending jobs3256151 and3263359 are excluded from measured labels.

OOM allocated/free/process values are rounded failure-point observations, not successful full-iteration peaks. Unknown values are null, not zero. A failed requested allocation was never successfully added to the live tensor total.

PyTorch peak allocated, peak reserved, process GPU usage and device total usage are distinct targets. Do not add allocated to reserved; reserved includes allocated. PyTorch allocator metrics do not include every external NCCL/HybridEP allocation.

OOM rows are censored fit/fail labels for the actual executed phase. They do not establish exact required peak memory or steady-state graph memory. NCCL OOMs lack requested-byte/free-memory snapshots.
Older full runs had sibling GPU contexts (~684MiB each on GPU0); GPU isolation changed in sequence1024 runs. Preserve that runtime difference when evaluating estimator error.

Per-rank passing metrics are step-window metrics reported by the training logger, not a sampled maximum of total device usage. CUDA graph replay and allocator peak-reset behavior can change later reported peaks. Use startup/warmup and steady-state separately.
Exact numerical parity for optimizer communication warmup was not established; PASS means verified functional training and traces, not bitwise equivalence.

Use effective_config for the complete saved configuration, including every layer, attention geometry, vision geometry, optimizer bucketing and sharding maps. Config JSON may serialize Python objects as repr; exact recipe and launcher are bundled to retain class identities.
